source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 mandatory declarations (English labels)
notes: Regexes are case-insensitive. 'required': true | 'conditional'. Check 'severity': 'fail' or 'review'. 'target': 'context' (default, keyword line + lookahead) or 'value'. 'stop_keywords' end a multi-line capture. 'min_height_ratio' compares the field's text height to the label's median (body) text height — approximate, not calibrated. 'unit_price_consistency' recomputes MRP / net quantity and compares it to the declared unit price within 'tolerance'. 'side_pattern' (optional) is used when the value sits in a column to the right of its label; defaults to value_pattern. 'fallback': 'pin_address' | 'tallest_text'.

fields.label: Name & address of manufacturer / packer / importer
fields.description: Name and complete address (with PIN code) of the manufacturer, packer or importer.
fields.pass_message: Manufacturer/packer name and address declared, with a PIN code.

checks.message: Address should include a 6-digit PIN code

fields.label: Common / generic name of the commodity
fields.description: Common or generic name of the commodity inside the package.

fields.label: Net quantity (standard units)
fields.description: Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number (g, kg, ml, L, N).
fields.pass_message: Net quantity declared in a standard unit.

checks.message: Non-standard unit symbol — use g, kg, mg, ml or L (not gm/gms/kgs/ltr)
Net quantity text looks smaller than the label's normal body text (approximate — no physical calibration)

fields.label: Month & year of manufacture / packing / import
fields.description: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import.
fields.pass_message: Month/year of manufacture or packing declared.

fields.label: Retail sale price (MRP) incl. of all taxes
fields.description: Retail sale price as Maximum Retail Price (MRP), stated as inclusive of all taxes.
fields.pass_message: MRP declared, inclusive of all taxes.

checks.message: MRP must be declared 'inclusive of all taxes'

fields.label: Consumer care details (phone / email)
fields.description: Consumer care details: telephone number and/or email for complaints.

fields.label: Unit sale price (e.g. Rs./kg) — applicable categories
fields.description: Unit sale price (e.g. Rs. per kg / per 100 g) — must equal MRP divided by net quantity.
fields.pass_message: Unit sale price declared and consistent with MRP / net quantity.

checks.message: Unit sale price doesn't match MRP / net quantity

clause_ref_note: Rule/clause references are indicative for the demo — verify against the current consolidated Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 before citing them in a notice.

penalties.offence: Selling/distributing a pre-packaged commodity whose package does not carry the required declarations
penalties.subsequent: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,00,000, or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both
penalties.note: Indicative maximum fine for a first offence, shown only when the label is likely non-compliant. The actual penalty is decided by the competent authority; check the Act as amended (incl. the Jan Vishwas Act, 2023) before relying on these figures.
